source.title: Irontold Hawkish Battle Armor (American Mecha)
source.author: maggiweber
source.notes: Powered armour rework (LANCE-19, 2026-10-31): a SimVehicle with a mech-style skeleton (joint_* with Walk and Run). The approved v1 fit (`stl_rig.py` with ~/craft/solid/mc2/stl/poweredarmor/joints.json, the Standing_01 sculpt) was recaptured by `hd_v2.py poweredarmor --steps fit,segment --folder vehicles`, then built through the mech path (`v3_mech.py`): rigid parts per original node with modelled joint actuators.
